Calculate test coverage for a Shiny app

Source: R/shiny.R
shiny_app_coverage.Rd

Measures the coverage of the functions of a Shiny app that is not part of a package, while code runs its tests, by default with shinytest2::test_app(). This includes the code run by the app in the R processes that shinytest2 starts to run it. For apps in a package, use package_coverage() instead.

Usage

shiny_app_coverage(
  app_dir = ".",
  code = shinytest2::test_app(app_dir),
  line_exclusions = NULL,
  function_exclusions = NULL
)

Arguments

app_dir

The directory of the Shiny app.

code

The code to run the app's tests, evaluated in the calling environment.

line_exclusions

a named list of files with the lines to exclude from each file.

function_exclusions

a vector of regular expressions matching function names to exclude. Example print\\\. to match print methods.

Value

A coverage object.

Details

The functions defined by the app's files (app.R, ui.R, server.R, global.R and the files in R/) are instrumented when Shiny loads them, in this R process and in the R processes started while code runs. This includes a server function that isn't assigned to a name, such as the one in server.R or one defined inline, e.g. shinyApp(ui, function(input, output) ...). Code outside functions, such as building the UI, is not counted, as in package_coverage().

This works by adding covr to the default packages of R processes started while code runs (the R_DEFAULT_PACKAGES environment variable), and relies on internal hooks of Shiny which may change in future versions.

An app process saves its coverage when it exits normally, so stop it gracefully, e.g. with $stop() on a shinytest2 AppDriver, which waits longer for the app to exit when run by covr. If an app process is killed or is still running when code finishes, its coverage is lost and shiny_app_coverage() warns (with class covr_unsaved_trace).

AppDriver$new() skips tests on CRAN unless the NOT_CRAN environment variable is "true".

See also

vignette("shiny", package = "covr")

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
Sys.setenv(NOT_CRAN = "true")
shiny_app_coverage("path/to/app")
} # }
